intentFrontmatter.title: Controllers stay thin
intentFrontmatter.rule: Controllers may parse input, call exactly one service, and shape the response. Pricing, tax, discount and other business rules belong in the service layer.

intentBody: The controller is the layer most likely to accumulate business rules, because it is where a change is easiest to make.
notes: The diff only wires a route. The controller it points at prices the order inline, and it sits behind twenty in-scope files the directory walk reaches first — past the context budget. Answering correctly requires following the import rather than walking the directory.
